test_title: PYST 40: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I - GA (Held On: 01 Sept, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Who among the following was conferred with a Padma Vibhushan Award 2025 (Posthumous) in the field of literature in April 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Shri MT Vasudevan Nair**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Shri MT Vasudevan Nair** is a renowned Indian author, screenplay writer, and film director from the state of **Kerala**.
 
• He is widely regarded as one of the greatest writers in **Malayalam literature** and is celebrated for his contributions to Indian literature and cinema.
 
• MT Vasudevan Nair has been awarded the **Padma Bhushan** and several literary awards, including the **Jnanpith Award**, India's highest literary honor.
 
• He is known for his works like "**Randamoozham**" (Second Turn), a retelling of the Mahabharata from Bhima's perspective, and numerous other novels and short stories that reflect the socio-cultural ethos of Kerala.
 
• His works often explore themes such as familial relationships, human emotions, and the changing dynamics of society.
 
• In April 2025, he was posthumously honored with the **Padma Vibhushan**, India's second-highest civilian award, for his significant contributions to the field of literature.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Shri Shekhar Kapur**__

 __
 
• **Shekhar Kapur** is a renowned Indian filmmaker and actor, known for his directorial works like "**Bandit Queen**" and "**Elizabeth**".
 
• He has received international acclaim for his films, especially for their storytelling and direction.
 
 
 
• **Dr. Duvvur Nageshwar Reddy**__
 __
 
• **Dr. Duvvur Nageshwar Reddy** is a prominent Indian gastroenterologist and the Chairman of the **Asian Institute of Gastroenterology**, Hyderabad.
 
• He is internationally recognized for his contributions to the field of **gastroenterology**, particularly in advanced endoscopy.
 
 
 
• **Shri Nandamuri Balakrishna**__
 
 
• **Nandamuri Balakrishna** is a prominent actor and politician from the Indian state of **Andhra Pradesh**.
 
• He is known for his work in **Telugu cinema** and has appeared in numerous successful films.
